newsitem.title: USA: Cypress Semi CEO sees modest Q4 revs growth.
newsitem.headline: Cypress Semi CEO sees modest Q4 revs growth.

text.p: Cypress Semiconductor Corp expects a modest improvement in revenues in the fourth quarter, but the ramping up of a new plant will temper profit growth, Chief Executive Officer T.J. Rodgers said on Friday.
"In December we're looking to modest revenue growth," he said in a conference call with analysts.
Profit growth "will probably be offset by the fact that we're now turning on our Philippines plant," he said.
Cypress executives said the overall average selling price (ASP) of the company's semiconductors in the third quarter was $2.68, down 12 percent from the second quarter.
